summary: Historia's wish is no longer to be chosen by her father. Uri and Frieda sit in Kenny's memory, while Rod's Titan crawls toward the people.

segments.ja: ヒストリアは、針を返した自分を光の下で見ます。見る自分は、父に必要とされた子供ではありません。ではありませんが、這う巨人が父であることは残ります。残った父は、壁の内側の人へ向かっています。向かう責任を、彼女は否の続きとして感じます。感じる続きが、今日の願いの起点です。起点は、褒められることではありません。自分で選んだ敵を、自分で止めることです。
segments.en: Historia looks, under the light, at the self that returned the needle. The self she looks at is not the child her father needed. Even so, it remains that the crawling Titan is her father. The father who remains is heading toward the people inside the walls. She feels the responsibility of that heading as the continuation of the no. The continuation she feels is the start of today's wish. The start is not being praised. It is stopping, herself, the enemy she chose.

segments.ja: エレンは、食べられることで罪を終わらせる願いを、まだ完全には捨てていません。捨てていない願いを、ヒストリアが正面から否定します。否定は、お前の死は私の正義ではない、という形です。形を、彼は驚きで受けます。受ける驚きが、父の骨を少しだけ外へ出します。外へ出た骨は、まだ消えていません。消えていなくても、彼は彼女の戦いに拳を貸す側へ戻ります。戻ることが、今日の彼の願いです。
segments.en: Eren has not yet fully thrown away the wish to end the sin by being eaten. Historia denies, from the front, the wish he has not thrown away. The denial is the shape: your death is not my justice. He receives the shape with surprise. The surprise he receives moves his father's bone a little outward. The bone that moved outward has not vanished yet. Even not vanished, he returns to the side that lends his fist to her fight. Returning is his wish today.

segments.ja: ケニーの中では、別の願いが古いです。古い願いは、ウーリにもう一度会うことです。会った夜、王家の当主は殺人者の前に膝をつきました。ついた言葉は、この世界の間違いをいつか直したい、です。直したい願いを、ケニーは力の魅力として覚えます。覚える魅力が、今日の銃の理由です。理由は、ロッドの肉を見たとたんに割れます。割れた願いが、友人は再現できない、と知らせます。
segments.en: Inside Kenny, another wish is old. The old wish is to meet Uri once more. On the night they met, the head of the royal house knelt in front of a killer. The words he put down were that he wanted someday to fix the mistake of this world. Kenny remembers the wish to fix it as the attraction of power. The attraction he remembers is the reason for today's guns. The reason cracks the moment he sees Rod's flesh. The cracked wish informs him that a friend cannot be reproduced.

segments.ja: 願いの底に、ケニーの妹クシェルがいます。妹の家で、彼は少年のリヴァイを見ました。見た少年を、彼は強くするために置き、そして離れました。離れたことが、今日の再会の元です。元を、彼は罪としては呼びません。呼ばない代わりに、自分が王家の友になりたかった事実だけを残します。残した事実は、アッカーマンには力が入らない、という遅すぎる知識で傷きます。傷いた知識が、銃を少し下ろします。その判断は、行列の速度を半歩だけ落とします。落とした半歩が、今日の幅です。
segments.en: At the bottom of the wish is Kenny's sister, Kuchel. In the sister's house, he saw the boy Levi. He left the boy he saw there in order to make him strong, and then he left. The leaving is the origin of today's reunion. He does not call the origin a sin. Instead of calling it, he leaves only the fact that he wanted to become a friend of the royal house. The fact he left is wounded by the too-late knowledge that power does not enter an Ackerman. The wounded knowledge lowers the gun a little. That judgment drops the column's speed by half a step. The dropped half step is today's width.

vocab.exampleJa: 残った父は、壁の内側の人へ向かっています。
vocab.exampleEn: Historia looks, under the light, at the self that returned the needle. The self she looks at is not the child her father needed. vocab.note: Kenny Ackerman. He leads the interior squad that hunts Eren and Historia, and he once raised Levi.
vocab.exampleJa: ケニーの中では、別の願いが古いです。
vocab.exampleEn: Inside Kenny, another wish is old. The old wish is to meet Uri once more. On the night they met, the head of the royal house knelt in front of a killer. The words he put down were that he wanted someday to fix the mistake of this world. Kenny remembers the wish to fix it as the attraction of power. The attraction he remembers is the reason for today's guns. The reason cracks the moment he sees Rod's flesh. The cracked wish informs him that a friend cannot be reproduced.

vocab.exampleJa: エレンは、食べられることで罪を終わらせる願いを、まだ完全には捨てていません。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren has not yet fully thrown away the wish to end the sin by being eaten. Historia denies, from the front, the wish he has not thrown away. The denial is the shape: your death is not my justice. He receives the shape with surprise. The surprise he receives moves his father's bone a little outward. The bone that moved outward has not vanished yet. Even not vanished, he returns to the side that lends his fist to her fight. Returning is his wish today.

vocab.exampleJa: 妹の家で、彼は少年のリヴァイを見ました。
vocab.exampleEn: At the bottom of the wish is Kenny's sister, Kuchel. In the sister's house, he saw the boy Levi. He left the boy he saw there in order to make him strong, and then he left. The leaving is the origin of today's reunion. He does not call the origin a sin. Instead of calling it, he leaves only the fact that he wanted to become a friend of the royal house. The fact he left is wounded by the too-late knowledge that power does not enter an Ackerman. The wounded knowledge lowers the gun a little. That judgment drops the column's speed by half a step. The dropped half step is today's width.

Historia enters by herself the role of not letting it in. The soldiers see the entering as a princess's recklessness. She says the recklessness they see is a wish. The contents of the wish are: do not let someone else kill my father.
